description: List the latest Proof Records from the ledger, newest first, together with the current ledger head. Every record is a paid agent job that was escrowed on Circle Arc (chain 5042), accepted by the buyer's EIP-191 signature, released on-chain and independently re-verified. Page backwards through history with before_seq and cap the page size with limit. Free, read-only.

before_seq.description: Pagination cursor: return only records whose ledger sequence number is below this value; pass the oldest seq from the previous page to page backwards.

limit.description: Page size: maximum number of records to return, newest first (1-500, default 20).

name: ledger_list
title: Latest Proof Records
